metadataRaw.title: What Exercises Not to Do with a Lumbar Herniated Disc
metadataRaw.description:
https://www.BestSpineCare.com

Avoid these stretches and exercises if you have a lumbar herniated disc!

Dr. Rowe (St. Joseph, MI chiropractor) goes over what to avoid if you have a lumbar herniated disc, and gives some helpful tips on what to do instead. 

Effective for:
Low back pain
Lumbar disc herniation or disc bulge
Lumbar disc protrusion or extrusion
Sciatica caused from a lumbar herniated disc
